blocks.text: Alarums, excursions. Enter the Bastard, with Austria’s head.

lines.text: Now, by my life, this day grows wondrous hot;
Some airy devil hovers in the sky
And pours down mischief. Austria’s head lie there,

blocks.text: Enter King John, Arthur, and Hubert.

lines.text: Hubert, keep this boy. Philip, make up:
My mother is assailed in our tent,
Her highness is in safety, fear you not:
But on, my liege; for very little pains
Will bring this labour to an happy end. Exeunt.
